_instructions: HOW TO USE (about 30 minutes): copy this file to eval\bailey_questions.json (RUN-MY-QUESTIONS.cmd does it for you), fill in the empty strings, save, then double-click RUN-MY-QUESTIONS.cmd.
real = 7 questions whose answer IS in your class notes (corpus folder). Write them in your own words, not copied from a heading. Mix easy and hard; at least one should need two sections.
trap = 3 questions whose answer is NOT in the notes. Make 1 plainly off-topic (cooking, sports) and 2 near the topic (sound like machine learning but your weeks never covered them).
Before you run it, write down for each real question which note should answer it: that is your answer key.
Leave a slot as an empty string to skip it. Keep the quotes and commas exactly as they are; only type between the quotes.
The run never changes MIN_SCORE and never touches the tuning or held-out sets. It writes eval\my_scorecard_<date-time>.md with empty right / half / wrong columns for YOU to mark.
